_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT (operator-directed) + A.1b
OBJECTIVE: Reduce the Scientists' context and repeated work while preserving scientific coverage, provenance, caveats and the independence of the blind first read. Minimum intervention, maximum measurable result.

mandatory_loads_removed: operator_manual.md 1.1 MINIMAL: 'caricare i 4 file current' -> the two large registries by record
operator_manual.md 2: the core file list now states per-record for both
operator_manual.md 7 RECOVERY: 'carica almeno i 4 current' -> model + claims + selective records
legend-start step 5: no profile below FULL loads either registry whole
legend-deepdive agent: paper registry by record
study-intake-triage agent: both registries by record
what_changed.phases_separated: standing brief M4b: the comparison is a phase after the receipt, not part of the blind read
what_changed.delegation_contract: roles/orchestrator.md — what a subagent receives and what a verifier must never receive

measurement.limit: characters carried, not provider-billed tokens; no scientific reading was run through the new path

independent_verification.delegate: general-purpose subagent, self-sufficient brief, no producer narrative or verdict
independent_verification.pass_1: 4 of 5 claims REFUTED over 22 PMIDs / 118 records: em-dash headings not boundaries; Source counted as identity (13 claims mislabelled); ambiguity keyed on the whole string (10 pairs missed); CORPUS P###/LIT-EX-### withheld as prose
independent_verification.pass_2: 6 of 6 CONFIRMED over 67 PMIDs, zero byte/label/presence differences; 2 further ambiguity misses found (bare PMID vs PMID+DOI) and repaired, plus a cosmetic DOI-digit leak in the key
independent_verification.lesson: this file's own suite passed while four of five guarantees were false, because it asked the same question with the same splitter

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: the manual's prescription and the observed behaviour disagree (mandated full load; zero Read calls in four transcripts, 24 ad-hoc Bash calls instead)
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: replace both with one deterministic record-level command and state the three epistemic statuses in the record
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: the prescription was costly and the habit returned fragments; whole records with provenance is strictly better than either
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: blessing grep would have kept the fragment risk that kills a caveat

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: the claim registry and the working model could receive the same treatment
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: evaluated separately and left loaded whole below FULL
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: they are the global state; a claim a paper contradicts may not be linked to that paper, so selective retrieval cannot promise to find it
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: a saving of 163 KB against a real risk of missing a contradiction

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: the first selective implementation measured WORSE than the baseline (602 KB and 689 KB against a 1,067 KB preload)
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: fix at the root by naming what is addressable, not by capping the output
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: a cap is silent truncation with a better name, and the mandate forbids it
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: a tool that hid what it dropped

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: one targeted delegation was authorised for implementation and independent verification
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: spend it entirely on verification, in two passes against the same brief; implement in-session
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: the implementation was small and the verification found four real defects the local suite could not

ATTRIBUTION_CENSUS.note: the six blind-auditor catches are the independent verifier's two passes; the machine catch is the em-dash regression surfacing in the local suite after the fix. Zero self-caught: the local suite agreed with the tool because it shared its splitter, which is the finding.

two_known_reds: unchanged and not weakened: test_batch_queue 80 vs 59 (operator's BATCH_COMMIT), test_surface_census (gitignored evidence). Re-run and quoted verbatim in the session record.

battery_and_publication.battery: 107 suites, FAIL on exactly the two inherited reds
